Cold Caller / Lead Follow-Up Specialist

Gutter Guru

Países permitidosLATAM, México
Modalidad100% Remote (Home Office)
Idioma requeridoInglés fluido
ExperienciaPrior experience in cold calling, appointment setting, or sales follow-up preferred
Salario$800 USD/month
HorarioFull-time
Tipo de contrataciónFull-time
Fecha de publicación2026-11-28 (Límite: 2026-12-28)

Descripción del puesto

Reconnect with warm leads who already requested a quote, answer basic questions, track outcomes in Pipedrive, and move prospects toward scheduling a service.

Funciones principales

  • Call warm leads who already received a quote to confirm receipt and answer basic questions.
  • Determine preferred scheduling dates or expected decision timelines.
  • Log call outcomes and next steps in Pipedrive CRM and maintain follow-up cadence.
  • Flag hot leads immediately and escalate complex pricing objections to management.

Requisitos

  • Clear, confident spoken English with a friendly, professional phone manner.
  • Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls daily.
  • Organized and experienced with CRM tools (Pipedrive is a plus).

Beneficios

  • 100% remote full-time role.
  • $800 USD/month compensation working with warm quoted leads.
